description: Works through SBA's refinancing rules (SOP 50 10 8.1, Appendix 14) for one debt. Call it with no inputs to get the first questions and their option values; each answer comes back with the rule and its citation, plus the questions still open. A rule screen, not a lender's decision.

debt.description: What is being refinanced. Call with no inputs to list the option values

improve_new.description: Expected new monthly payment, in dollars (optional)

improve_old.description: Current total monthly payment on the debts being refinanced, in dollars (optional)

prog.description: The SBA program for the new loan. Call with no inputs to list the option values

name: check_sba_refinance
title: Can SBA refinance this debt?
